positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and support C, C++, and C# Software/Firmware for embedded and desktop applications.
Develop, support, and maintain test fixtures, software, and calibration equipment.
Develop and interpret equipment specifications and schematics.
Review board schematics to ensure proper functionality.
Troubleshoot firmware vs. electrical issues, hardware, and software, during PCBA development/testing.
Conduct product operational, control-loop behavior and performance testing utilizing data loggers, oscilloscopes, multimeters
Provide support to global service centers and factories in troubleshooting and resolving hardware/software and system problems.

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Circuit Characterization of DC/DC power supplies, data signals (I2C, SPI, CAN, MDIO, UART, MMC, RGMII, GMSL)
Schematic and layout design using Allegro/orCAD
PCBA level reworks, bring up, testing and validation 
Power and Signal Integrity Simulation/Analysis (IRDrop, PDN) using Sigrity, LTSpice
positions.insights: Layout Design, Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) and +16 skills

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Designed PCB Schematics, Layout, Constraints, and Routing using Altium
Create manufacturing outputs (gerber files, artwork)
Assembled PCBs & components into PCBA
PCBA level reworks, bring up, debug, and validation
Developed firmware for STM MCUs, LoRA transmitters, and digital microphones
positions.insights: Layout Design, Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) and +16 skills
